data_fields.name: clampMargin
data_fields.donor_constant: half the widget x zoom (no fixed constant)

best_idea: A world map whose zoom keeps the point under the cursor fixed (discrete zoom steps as data), whose pan is clamped so part of the zone always stays in the middle of the widget, and whose click cancels the player's follow target before moving the view.
decision_why: Keep zoom about the cursor on a discrete step table, the centre-keeping clamp, and cancel-follow on a manual move; reject the 2:1 iso pixel and sub-pixel arithmetic, which exists only for the donor's iso pixel grid. No defect found in the lines read.
acceptance: A player scrolls the wheel over a spot on the zone map and that spot stays under the cursor through the zoom; panning stops with the zone edge at the middle of the widget; a click on the map ends any follow and the view moves to the clicked point.
